## Setup

```{r, message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)

cfg <- list(
  data_dir = file.path("data", "5min"),
  timezone = "UTC",
  analysis_start_date = as.Date("2025-03-01"),
  steps_cutoff = 840,
  steps_bin_width = 10,
  minimum_subjects = 10
)
```

## Data import

Study window: `2025-03-01 < date < Sys.Date()` (UTC), with one row per `userId` and `bucket_5min`.

```{r, message=FALSE}
if (!exists("myair_5min", inherits = FALSE)) {
  myair_5min <- read_csv(
    file.path(cfg$data_dir, "myair_5min.csv.gz"),
    col_types = cols(userId = col_character(), bucket_5min = col_datetime(), deviceId = col_character(), firmware = col_character()),
    locale = locale(tz = "UTC"), na = c("", "NA", "NULL"), show_col_types = FALSE
  )
}
air <- myair_5min
air <- air %>%
  filter(
    as.Date(bucket_5min, tz = cfg$timezone) > cfg$analysis_start_date,
    as.Date(bucket_5min, tz = cfg$timezone) < Sys.Date()
  )

if (!exists("smartwatchhigh_5min", inherits = FALSE)) {
  smartwatchhigh_5min <- read_csv(
    file.path(cfg$data_dir, "smartwatchhigh_5min.csv.gz"),
    col_types = cols(userId = col_character(), bucket_5min = col_datetime(), deviceId = col_character(), firmware = col_character()),
    locale = locale(tz = "UTC"), na = c("", "NA", "NULL"), show_col_types = FALSE
  )
}
swh <- smartwatchhigh_5min
swh <- swh %>%
  filter(
    as.Date(bucket_5min, tz = cfg$timezone) > cfg$analysis_start_date,
    as.Date(bucket_5min, tz = cfg$timezone) < Sys.Date()
  )

if (!exists("smartwatchlow_5min", inherits = FALSE)) {
  smartwatchlow_5min <- read_csv(
    file.path(cfg$data_dir, "smartwatchlow_5min.csv.gz"),
    col_types = cols(userId = col_character(), bucket_5min = col_datetime(), deviceId = col_character(), firmware = col_character()),
    locale = locale(tz = "UTC"), na = c("", "NA", "NULL"), show_col_types = FALSE
  )
}
swl <- smartwatchlow_5min
swl <- swl %>%
  filter(
    as.Date(bucket_5min, tz = cfg$timezone) > cfg$analysis_start_date,
    as.Date(bucket_5min, tz = cfg$timezone) < Sys.Date()
  )
```

## Heart-rate dataset

Heart-rate buckets are retained; activity and environment are matched by participant and bucket.

`step_mean` averages repeated minute readings; it is not their sum.

```{r}
hr_dat <- swh %>%
  transmute(
    userId,
    bucket_5min,
    heartrate = heartrate_mean,
    heartrate_min,
    heartrate_max
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    swl %>%
      transmute(
        userId,
        bucket_5min,
        steps = step_mean
      ),
    by = c("userId", "bucket_5min"),
    relationship = "one-to-one"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    air %>%
      transmute(
        userId,
        bucket_5min,
        temperature = temperature_mean,
        humidity = humidity_mean
      ),
    by = c("userId", "bucket_5min"),
    relationship = "one-to-one"
  ) %>%
  arrange(userId, bucket_5min) %>%
  mutate(userId = factor(userId))
```

```{r}
rm(air, swh, swl)
```

## Derived variables

Humidex uses temperature and relative humidity; heart-rate range is the within-bucket maximum minus minimum.

```{r}
hr_dat <- hr_dat %>%
  mutate(
    humidex = ThermIndex::humidex(
      temp = temperature,
      ur = humidity
    ),
    heartrate_range = heartrate_max - heartrate_min
  )
```

## Within-subject heart rate

Heart rate is expressed in bpm relative to each participant's mean.

```{r}
hr_dat <- hr_dat %>%
  group_by(userId) %>%
  mutate(
    heartrate_personal_mean = mean(heartrate, na.rm = TRUE),
    heartrate_c = heartrate - heartrate_personal_mean
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```

## Data coverage

```{r}
hr_dat %>%
  summarise(
    observations = n(),
    subjects = n_distinct(userId),
    heart_rate_observations = sum(!is.na(heartrate)),
    heart_rate_with_steps = sum(!is.na(heartrate) & !is.na(steps)),
    heart_rate_with_humidex = sum(!is.na(heartrate) & !is.na(humidex))
  ) %>%
  knitr::kable(
    format = "pipe",
    col.names = c(
      "Rows",
      "Subjects",
      "Heart rate",
      "Heart rate and steps",
      "Heart rate and Humidex"
    ),
    caption = "Heart-rate dataset coverage"
  )
```

# Physical activity and heart rate

## Joint distribution

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=6.5}
hr_dat %>%
  filter(!is.na(steps), !is.na(heartrate_c)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = steps, y = heartrate_c)) +
  geom_hex(bins = 120) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_fill_distiller(
    palette = "Spectral",
    direction = -1,
    transform = "log10",
    breaks = c(1, 10, 100, 1000, 10000, 100000),
    labels = scales::label_number(
      big.mark = ".",
      decimal.mark = ","
    ),
    name = "Observations\n(log10 scale)"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Physical activity and heart rate",
    subtitle = "Heart rate centered within subject",
    x = "Steps in five minutes",
    y = "Heart rate relative to personal mean (bpm)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Heart rate by step interval

Summaries use `r cfg$steps_bin_width`-step intervals.

```{r}
hr_steps_summary <- hr_dat %>%
  filter(!is.na(steps), !is.na(heartrate_c)) %>%
  mutate(steps_bin = floor(steps / cfg$steps_bin_width) * cfg$steps_bin_width) %>%
  group_by(steps_bin) %>%
  summarise(
    observations = n(),
    subjects = n_distinct(userId),
    mean_heartrate_c = mean(heartrate_c),
    q25 = quantile(heartrate_c, 0.25),
    q75 = quantile(heartrate_c, 0.75),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=6.5}
hr_steps_summary %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = steps_bin, y = mean_heartrate_c)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = q25, ymax = q75), alpha = 0.25) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(aes(color = subjects), size = 2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_color_distiller(
    palette = "Spectral",
    direction = -1,
    name = "Subjects",
    breaks = c(10, 50, 100, 150)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Heart rate response to physical activity",
    subtitle = "Mean and interquartile range within 10-step intervals",
    x = "Steps in five minutes",
    y = "Heart rate relative to personal mean (bpm)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Support for high-activity intervals

```{r}
hr_steps_summary %>%
  filter(steps_bin >= 500) %>%
  mutate(
    mean_heartrate_c = round(mean_heartrate_c, 1),
    q25 = round(q25, 1),
    q75 = round(q75, 1)
  ) %>%
  knitr::kable(
    format = "pipe",
    col.names = c(
      "Steps",
      "Observations",
      "Subjects",
      "Mean HR",
      "Q25",
      "Q75"
    ),
    caption = "Support for high-activity intervals"
  )
```

Values ≥ `r cfg$steps_cutoff` steps/5 min are excluded because of sparse upper-tail support in the earlier snapshot. This is an exploratory cutoff, not a physiological limit.

```{r}
hr_steps_dat <- hr_dat %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(steps),
    !is.na(heartrate_c),
    steps < cfg$steps_cutoff
  ) %>%
  droplevels()
```

# Activity-adjusted heart rate

A GAM and a cubic polynomial describe the activity–heart-rate association.

```{r}
hr_steps_dat <- hr_steps_dat %>%
  mutate(steps_100 = steps / 100)

hr_steps_gam <- mgcv::bam(
  heartrate_c ~ s(steps, k = 30),
  data = hr_steps_dat,
  method = "fREML",
  discrete = TRUE
)

hr_steps_cubic <- lm(
  heartrate_c ~
    steps_100 +
    I(steps_100^2) +
    I(steps_100^3),
  data = hr_steps_dat
)
```

## Model comparison

```{r}
gam_summary <- summary(hr_steps_gam)
cubic_summary <- summary(hr_steps_cubic)

hr_steps_model_comparison <- tibble(
  model = c(
    "GAM: s(steps, k = 30)",
    "Cubic polynomial"
  ),
  variance_explained = c(
    gam_summary$dev.expl,
    cubic_summary$adj.r.squared
  ),
  residual_sd = c(
    sqrt(gam_summary$scale),
    cubic_summary$sigma
  ),
  complexity = c(
    paste0(round(gam_summary$s.table[1, "edf"], 1), " EDF"),
    "3 polynomial terms"
  )
) %>%
  mutate(
    variance_explained = scales::percent(
      variance_explained,
      accuracy = 0.1
    ),
    residual_sd = round(residual_sd, 2)
  )

hr_steps_model_comparison %>%
  knitr::kable(
    format = "pipe",
    col.names = c(
      "Model",
      "Variance explained",
      "Residual SD",
      "Complexity"
    ),
    caption = "Physical-activity model comparison"
  )
```

## Fitted relationships

```{r}
steps_predictions <- tibble(
  steps = seq(
    min(hr_steps_dat$steps),
    max(hr_steps_dat$steps),
    length.out = 500
  )
) %>%
  mutate(steps_100 = steps / 100)

steps_predictions <- steps_predictions %>%
  mutate(
    gam = predict(
      hr_steps_gam,
      newdata = steps_predictions
    ),
    cubic = predict(
      hr_steps_cubic,
      newdata = steps_predictions
    )
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(gam, cubic),
    names_to = "model",
    values_to = "expected_heartrate"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    model = recode(
      model,
      gam = "GAM",
      cubic = "Cubic polynomial"
    )
  )
```

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=6.5}
steps_predictions %>%
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = steps,
      y = expected_heartrate,
      linetype = model
    )
  ) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Modeled association between physical activity and heart rate",
    subtitle = "Comparison between the GAM and cubic polynomial",
    x = "Steps in five minutes",
    y = "Expected heart rate relative to personal mean (bpm)",
    linetype = "Model"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

The cubic fit is retained for exploratory adjustment, not selected through independent validation. Neither model accounts for within-subject dependence.

## Activity-adjusted outcome

```{r}
hr_steps_dat <- hr_steps_dat %>%
  mutate(
    heartrate_activity_expected = fitted(hr_steps_cubic),
    heartrate_activity_adj = residuals(hr_steps_cubic)
  )
```

`heartrate_activity_adj` is the cubic-model residual (bpm); positive values exceed the activity-based prediction.

## Residual association with physical activity

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=6.5}
hr_steps_dat %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = steps, y = heartrate_activity_adj)) +
  geom_hex(bins = 120) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_fill_distiller(
    palette = "Spectral",
    direction = -1,
    transform = "log10",
    name = "Observations\n(log10 scale)"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Activity-adjusted heart rate",
    subtitle = "Residual heart rate after cubic adjustment for steps",
    x = "Steps in five minutes",
    y = "Activity-adjusted heart rate (bpm)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

# Thermal exposure and activity-adjusted heart rate

## Humidex

Within each one-unit Humidex interval, participant means receive equal weight. Intervals require at least `r cfg$minimum_subjects` participants to limit sparse support.

```{r}
hr_humidex_summary <- hr_steps_dat %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(humidex),
    !is.na(heartrate_activity_adj)
  ) %>%
  mutate(humidex_bin = floor(humidex)) %>%
  group_by(userId, humidex_bin) %>%
  summarise(
    user_mean = mean(heartrate_activity_adj),
    observations = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(humidex_bin) %>%
  summarise(
    observations = sum(observations),
    subjects = n(),
    mean_heartrate_adj = mean(user_mean),
    sd_between_subjects = sd(user_mean),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(subjects >= cfg$minimum_subjects) %>%
  mutate(
    se = sd_between_subjects / sqrt(subjects),
    ci_low =
      mean_heartrate_adj -
      qt(0.975, df = subjects - 1) * se,
    ci_high =
      mean_heartrate_adj +
      qt(0.975, df = subjects - 1) * se
  )
```

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=6.5}
hr_humidex_summary %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = humidex_bin, y = mean_heartrate_adj)) +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(ymin = ci_low, ymax = ci_high),
    alpha = 0.15
  ) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(aes(color = subjects), size = 2.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_color_distiller(
    palette = "Spectral",
    direction = -1,
    name = "Subjects"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Humidex and activity-adjusted heart rate",
    subtitle = "Subject-balanced mean and 95% confidence interval",
    x = "Humidex",
    y = "Activity-adjusted heart rate (bpm)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

Formal inference requires joint modelling of activity and thermal exposure with within-subject dependence.
